rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and the provided 2BA label, but it overstates expansion/thinning of the zona and calls the embryo high-quality/top-tier despite only moderate expansion and a somewhat limited image-based assessment of ICM/TE.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrium, and repeated failed cycles into prognosis reasonably well, though some links (e.g., diet deficiencies) are speculative and not clearly tied to this embryo.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with the implantation estimate adjusted downward for repeated failures; minor issues include labeling 2BA as excellent/top-tier and assuming prior failures imply a hostile uterine environment.

Mostly aligned on embryo assessment and considering uterine/sperm factors after repeated failures, but ERA as 'standard,' routine aspirin suggestion, and strong endorsement of PGT-A in a 29-year-old are not fully guideline-supported.

Provides clear next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including hysteroscopy/endometritis workup and sperm DNA fragmentation testing, though some recommendations are more aggressive than evidence-based standards.
